disambiguation: Not an RSS or read-later service; it opens ebook and comic files kept in the vault.
extras: AI is off by default and keys are stored with Obsidian SecretStorage; CLI providers are desktop-only; no built-in OCR or cross-book semantic search; physical mobile-device validation is pending; a separate community build excludes the ACP dependency installer.
intentEvidence: If you used Qiaomu Book Reader before, back up your vault and disable it before enabling the new plugin
